label: Traditional Pop / Vocal Jazz / Orchestral Ballad

cards.mood: The piece opens with a gentle, anticipatory warmth that establishes a serene atmosphere.
cards.vocal: Singer A (Male) and Ensemble B (Mixed Choir).
cards.palette: A full string section serves as the primary harmonic and melodic driver, providing sweeping legato lines that swell during the choruses and recede during the verses.

cards.mood: The piece opens with a dramatic, cinematic orchestral flourish that immediately establishes a grand, nostalgic tone.
cards.palette: A grand piano serves as the harmonic anchor, playing arpeggiated chords and melodic fills from the beginning to the end, providing a consistent rhythmic and tonal foundation.
